literal: If those who beg are not there, the cool, wide, great world is like a wooden puppet going and coming.
translation: If there were no beggars to ask for alms, the movements of people in this vast, cool world would be like the mere coming and going of wooden puppets.
modern: இரந்து கேட்பவர்கள் இல்லையென்றால், குளிர்ந்த இடத்தையுடைய இந்த பெரிய உலகத்தில் வாழும் மக்களின் இயக்கம், மரப்பாவை தானாகவே சென்று வருவது போன்றதாகும்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the social and human value of giving and receiving. The author suggests that if there were no people who ask for help, the act of giving charity would cease to exist. Without the interplay of giving and receiving, human life would lose its warmth, empathy, and social connection. Consequently, the people moving about in this vast, cool world would be no different from lifeless wooden puppets controlled by strings, moving mechanically without true human spirit.
